sloka: तत्र वृद्धो महा मात्रः सिद्ध अर्थो नाम नामतः ।शुचिर् बहु मतः राज्ञः कैकेयीम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-३६-१८॥
transliteration: tatra vṛddho mahā mātraḥ siddha artho nāma nāmataḥ ।śucir bahu mataḥ rājñaḥ kaikeyīm idam abravīt ॥2-36-18॥

translations.english: An aged minister named Siddhartha who justified his name, highly respected by the king said this to Kaikeyi:
